name: Double-spend: two {{withdraw}} calls before the callback resolves
description: Deposit 5 NEAR, send two `{{withdraw}}`(5 NEAR) calls in the same block; no more than 5 NEAR may come out.

checks.message: Neither withdraw succeeded (`{{withdraw}}`: {error.w1}), so the race was not exercised.

Double-spend: attacker.near deposited 5.0000 NEAR, sent two `{{withdraw}}` calls in the same block, and came out {net.attacker} ahead. The balance is checked but not debited before the payout, so both calls pass; the extra came out of other depositors' funds.

explain.held: Two same-block `{{withdraw}}` calls paid out no more than the 5.0000 NEAR deposited. The second call was refused, so nothing was spent twice.
